reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed V4 (agent's declared best variant): linear single-track with fitted C_alpha_f=401575, C_alpha_r=389774 (from out/ladder_results.json) using MACH_E mechanical params, per-segment bias subtraction on straight samples, then LOO-CV Ridge(alpha=1) residual learner over features [v, |a_y_pred|, |delta|, sign(ddelta)], extended to the full Ford canonical set.
notes: Agent only scored Mach-E (315 segs); reconstruction extends V4 to the full 545-segment Ford canonical set, applying their MACH_E-fitted C_alpha + MACH_E mechanical params to F-150 segments as well — so V4's residual learner is now trained LOO over a mixed-platform pool. Per-segment bias is computed from each segment's own straight samples, so it remains platform-fair. Sanity-check: baseline_rmse_recomputed matches the precomputed V0 within 1e-6.
